scope: Make DRW_Light DWG encoding transactional across body, detached strings, and handle streams, and test allocation-failure rollback with same-object retry.

changes: Keep existing version, CMC, scalar-domain, and finite-value validation before the transaction begins.
Route the common header, light and optional photometric fields, CMC strings, entity handle, and oType mutation through encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores oType; same-object retry against the same buffers reproduces clean output exactly.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 2,894 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, ARCALIGNEDTEXT, and LIGHT; 6 HATCH-family/ARCALIGNEDTEXT versions, 3 MLEADER versions and 4 LIGHT versions; 125 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: Generated LIGHT control encodes common name, position and target, plus a selected AC1021+ color method and metadata presence through detached string/body/handle alias configurations.
LIGHT writer revisions AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 are exercised in all five stream alias layouts.
Each injected failure verifies all buffer bytes and bit positions, object-type rollback and exact successful retry.
limitations: The generated LIGHT transaction check does not qualify native lighting semantics, photometric data, producer breadth, or consumer rendering.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
